column1: # kinds      tokens: in the verse own (the transcription's reference book.chapter.verse) the tokens before, standing there once, become those of after (none where after is \N); opens: from the tokens before to the verse's end the words open the verse after names first, with the tokens after that in place of before; moves: every token of the verse moves to the reference after. Rows apply in this file's order, each to the verse as the rows before it left it

# note       the Old Greek of Susanna, Daniel and Bel in Swete's volume 3 (files 54, 56, 58 of lxx-swete), corrected as Swete's own books are: a Latin letter for the Greek one it looks exactly like, a verse number let into the text in figures taken out and the word kept, and in the song of Daniel 3 a word whose first letters a figure took written as the verses on either side print it
